We visited ResearchAyu Knee Expert Clinic – Khar branch after being assured that knee pain would be completely cured in 20 days. We paid ₹58,000 for the first 20 days based on that promise.

If you are planning to start treatment here, please do not assume your knee problem will be fully cured in 20 days. Ayurvedic treatment naturally takes time (usually 3–6 months) for proper healing, so promising complete recovery in just 20 days feels misleading. Many people may trust such claims and end up spending ₹3–4 lakhs within a couple of months.

Please be careful and clarify the full treatment plan and total expected cost before making payment. Don’t get influenced by their doctor and managers and positive reviews on google or Instagram— make your decision only after thorough research and clear written commitments from their end.
